findings.evidence: File body needs only `counit`, `comul`, `IsGroupLikeElem`, `Algebra.TensorProduct.map`. Repo convention already separates generic layers: `TauCeti/Algebra/Bialgebra/TensorProduct.lean`, `TauCeti/Algebra/Bialgebra/GroupLike/Evaluation.lean`, `TauCeti/Algebra/HopfAlgebra/GroupLike/FiniteGeneration.lean`; the sibling files `CommHopfAlgCat/{Basic,BaseChange,Yoneda,SchemePoints}.lean` are all genuinely categorical.
findings.fix: Move that block to a generic file under `TauCeti/Algebra/Bialgebra/` (e.g. `TauCeti/Algebra/Bialgebra/GroupLike/Galois.lean`, next to `GroupLike/Map.lean`), stated for `{A : Type*} [CommRing A] [Bialgebra k A]`; keep only `geometricCharacterGroup`, `characterLattice` and their transported actions in the `CommHopfAlgCat` file.
findings.issue: Lines 56–166 (`galoisScalarMap`, `galoisScalarMap_tmul/one/mul/smul`, `galoisScalarSemilinearMap`, `counit_galoisScalarMap`, `comul_galoisScalarMap`, `isGroupLikeElem_galoisScalarMap`, `instGaloisScalarMulSemiringAction`) are generic bialgebra base-change statements: `H : CommHopfAlgCat.{u} k` is used only as a commutative bialgebra carrier — no category theory, no antipode, no AlgebraicGroup theory. Bundling them here buries dependency-light, broadly useful material (Galois descent, twisted forms) in the late AlgebraicGroup/bundled-category layer and makes the semilinear action and the `MulSemiringAction` instance unavailable for any unbundled `k̄ ⊗[k] A`.

findings.evidence: `MultiplicativeType/Basic.lean:9` `public import ...DiagonalizableGroup.EssentialImage`; `EssentialImage.lean:8` `public import ...DiagonalizableGroup.FiniteType`. Used declarations resolve to `EssentialImage` (`groupLikeSpannedProperty`, `groupLikeSpannedProperty_iff`), `MultiplicativeType.Basic`, `FiniteType/BaseChange`, and `HopfAlgebra/GroupLike/FiniteGeneration`.
findings.issue: `public import TauCeti.Algebra.AlgebraicGroup.DiagonalizableGroup.FiniteType` is unused: the 20-line body references no declaration from that file (`coordinateRing`, `coordinateRingFunctor`, `FGCommGrpCat` never appear), and it is reachable anyway via `MultiplicativeType.Basic → DiagonalizableGroup.EssentialImage → DiagonalizableGroup.FiniteType`.

findings.evidence: `Mathlib/RingTheory/Bialgebra/GroupLike.lean` defines `GroupLike`, its `Monoid` instance (line 76), `val_injective`, and imports `Mathlib.RingTheory.Coalgebra.GroupLike` supplying `IsGroupLikeElem.map` (line 52) — everything `Map.lean` uses; nothing in the file needs the antipode or the `Group` instance from the Hopf file.
findings.issue: A bialgebra-level file (`variable [Bialgebra R A] [Bialgebra R B]`, only `BialgHom`/`BialgEquiv` content) imports the Hopf-algebra module `Mathlib.RingTheory.HopfAlgebra.GroupLike`, pulling the Hopf layer into `TauCeti/Algebra/Bialgebra/` unnecessarily.

summary: The five `CharacterLattice.lean` files sit in the right topic subdirectories, but the semilinear absolute-Galois action in `CommHopfAlgCat/CharacterLattice.lean` is generic bialgebra material locked into the bundled AlgebraicGroup layer and should move to `TauCeti/Algebra/Bialgebra/`. Two import issues: an unused `DiagonalizableGroup.FiniteType` import and a Hopf-level import in a bialgebra-level file.
